steps.en: Install the Python package on a CUDA machine (Python 3.10+, PyTorch 2.5+)
steps.zh: 在带 CUDA 的机器上装 Python 包

steps.en: Load the model by its Hugging Face id
steps.zh: 按 Hugging Face 上的模型名加载

steps.en: Downloads the 2B weights, rebuilds the network from config.json and warms it up with torch.compile
steps.zh: 下载 2B 权重，重建网络并用 torch.compile 预热

steps.en: Call generate with the text and a short clip of the voice to copy
steps.zh: 调用 generate，传入要说的文字和一小段目标音色录音

steps.en: A language model plans the speech as continuous latents; a small diffusion head paints in the acoustic detail
steps.zh: 语言模型把语音规划成连续潜向量，小扩散头补上声学细节

steps.en: Decodes the latents into a 48kHz waveform and returns it as a NumPy array
steps.zh: 把潜向量解码成 48kHz 波形，以 NumPy 数组返回

steps.en: Write the array to a WAV file
steps.zh: 把数组写成 WAV 文件

value.en: A cloned or designed voice in 30 languages at 48kHz from Apache-2.0 weights on your own GPU — no per-character API bill and no non-commercial weight license
value.zh: 在自己的 GPU 上用 Apache-2.0 权重合成 30 种语言的克隆或设计音色——不按字付费，也不怕禁商用

sources: https://github.com/OpenBMB/VoxCPM README (Installation: pip install voxcpm; Requirements: Python >= 3.10 (<3.13), PyTorch >= 2.5.0, CUDA >= 12.0; Python API: VoxCPM.from_pretrained("openbmb/VoxCPM2", load_denoiser=False); Controllable Voice Cloning: reference_wav_path="path/to/voice.wav"; sf.write("clone.wav", wav, model.tts_model.sample_rate))
https://github.com/OpenBMB/VoxCPM src/voxcpm/core.py (from_pretrained -> huggingface_hub snapshot_download; architecture read from config.json; optimize=True -> torch.compile warm-up generate)
https://github.com/OpenBMB/VoxCPM README Models & Versions (four-stage pipeline LocEnc -> TSLM -> RALM -> LocDiT in the AudioVAE V2 latent space; 48kHz output)
